messages.content: Internal knowledge base

Here's what I've understood:

- **Product:** Internal Assistant Chatbot
- **Users:** Company employees / internal staff
- **Core Purpose:** Provide quick answers and assistance using the internal knowledge base
- **Knowledge Sources:** Internal knowledge base (documents, FAQs, policies)
- **Persistence:** Store conversation history per user for context and analytics
- **Recommended Stack:** Next.js + TypeScript + TailwindCSS + Supabase

Let me know when you're ready to create the build plan!

buildPlans.title: Internal Assistant Chatbot with Knowledge Base Search and On‑Call Escalation
buildPlans.summary: Build a Next.js + TypeScript internal chatbot that queries a Supabase‑hosted knowledge base, stores per‑user conversation history, and escalates unanswered queries to on‑call staff via email.

steps.title: Define system architecture
steps.description: Create a high‑level diagram covering Next.js frontend, API routes, Supabase auth/DB, AI service integration, and email escalation flow. Document data models for users, messages, and knowledge base entries.

steps.title: Configure Supabase backend
steps.description: Set up Supabase project with Auth, tables (users, conversations, messages, kb_documents, oncall_staff), and Row Level Security. Add initial migrations and enable Realtime for conversation updates.

steps.title: Implement backend API endpoints
steps.description: Create Next.js API routes for: • /api/chat – receive user messages, store them, call AI, and return responses. • /api/search – perform full‑text search on kb_documents using Supabase vector or text search. • /api/escalate – trigger email to on‑call staff when AI confidence is low.

steps.title: Build frontend chat interface
steps.description: Develop React components with TailwindCSS: ChatWindow (displays message list with realtime updates), MessageInput (composer with send button), Loading/Error states, and Escalation banner. Wire components to the API routes and Supabase auth.

steps.title: Integrate, test, and configure deployment
steps.description: Add integration tests for API flow (message handling, search, escalation). Configure environment variables (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, SENDGRID_API_KEY). Set up CI pipeline to run tests and deploy to Vercel.

risks: AI response latency or rate‑limit throttling could degrade user experience.
Storing conversation history may raise compliance/privacy concerns if not properly scoped.
assumptions: The internal knowledge base is already structured in Supabase tables (documents, FAQs, policies).
An OpenAI (or compatible) API key is available for generating AI responses.
On‑call escalation will be handled via email using a service like SendGrid, and the on‑call list is maintained in a Supabase table.

buildPlans.title: Internal Assistant Chatbot Build Plan
buildPlans.summary: Create a Next.js + TypeScript chatbot for company employees that leverages an internal knowledge base, stores conversation history per user in Supabase, and provides a responsive UI with TailwindCSS.

steps.title: Project scaffolding & core configuration
steps.description: Initialize a Next.js TypeScript project, install TailwindCSS, Supabase client, and configure environment variables. Set up Tailwind, ESLint, and Prettier for consistent code style.

steps.title: Define Supabase schema for conversation persistence
steps.description: Create tables: 'conversations' (id, user_id, created_at) and 'messages' (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at). Enable Row Level Security (RLS) so users can only access their own data.

steps.title: Backend API for chat handling
steps.description: Implement /api/chat endpoint: validate session, retrieve or create a conversation, query internal knowledge base, call the AI service, store user and assistant messages in Supabase, and return the assistant reply.

steps.title: Frontend chat UI and state management
steps.description: Build reusable components: ChatInterface (message list), MessageComposer (input + send button), and ConversationContext (React context for loading state, error handling, and message list). Apply TailwindCSS for responsive design and add loading/error UI states.

steps.title: Integration testing, error handling & deployment config
steps.description: Write unit and integration tests for API route and UI components using Jest and React Testing Library. Add global error boundaries, configure Supabase edge functions for secure API calls, and prepare Vercel deployment settings.

risks: API rate limits or latency could affect response times.
Storing sensitive conversation data requires strict access controls and compliance.
assumptions: An internal knowledge base API is available for querying relevant documents.
OpenAI (or similar) API key is provided for generating AI responses.
Supabase authentication will be used for employee login.

buildPlans.title: Customer Support Chatbot with Ticket Routing
buildPlans.summary: Implement a web‑based chatbot that handles customer inquiries, provides AI‑generated responses, logs conversations, and routes unresolved issues to an external ticketing system.

steps.title: Define system architecture
steps.description: Create an architecture diagram covering frontend chat widget, backend message processor, AI response service, ticketing integration, and conversation database. Document data flow and security considerations.

steps.title: Develop frontend chat widget
steps.description: Build a reusable React component for the chat UI, including message list, input composer, loading spinner, and error toast. Connect to backend via WebSocket for real‑time messages.

steps.title: Implement backend message processing API
steps.description: Create Express routes to receive user messages, forward them to the OpenAI API, store the exchange, and return AI responses. Include validation and basic rate limiting.

steps.title: Integrate ticket routing service
steps.description: Add logic to detect unresolved intents using confidence thresholds, then call the external ticketing REST API to create a ticket and return the ticket ID to the user.

steps.title: Design conversation logging database
steps.description: Define a PostgreSQL schema for conversations (session_id, user_message, bot_response, timestamp, ticket_id). Add Sequelize models and migration scripts.

steps.title: Write end‑to‑end tests
steps.description: Create Jest/SuperTest suites covering chat flow, AI response handling, ticket creation on low‑confidence intents, and database persistence. Automate in CI pipeline.

risks: API rate limits or latency could degrade user experience
Incorrect intent classification may cause tickets to be created for resolved queries
assumptions: OpenAI GPT model is accessible via an existing API key
Ticketing system (e.g., Zendesk) exposes a REST API for ticket creation
Frontend is built with React and uses WebSocket for real‑time updates

steps.title: Create Frontend Chat Widget

steps.title: Integration Testing & Deployment Prep

risks: LLM rate limits or latency could affect user experience.
Storing raw conversation text may raise privacy compliance concerns.
assumptions: An OpenAI (or equivalent LLM) API key is available for generating answers.
Documentation and FAQs are accessible as markdown or JSON files in the repo.
A Supabase project is already created and its credentials are available.

buildPlans.title: Customer Support Chatbot Build Plan
buildPlans.summary: Implement a website‑embedded support chatbot using Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Supabase. The bot will answer FAQs, retrieve documentation, and persist conversation history per user.

steps.title: Define Architecture & Data Model
steps.description: Create an architecture diagram outlining the ChatWidget, API layer, Supabase tables (users, conversations, messages), and external AI service. Draft the relational schema and decide on JWT‑based user identification.

steps.title: Set Up Supabase Schema
steps.description: Write SQL migrations to create tables: users(id, email), conversations(id, user_id, created_at), messages(id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at). Enable Row Level Security policies for user‑scoped access.

steps.title: Implement Backend Chat API
steps.description: Create pages/api/chat.ts that receives user messages, stores them, calls the AI service with context (FAQ snippets + conversation history), saves the AI reply, and returns the response. Include error handling and rate‑limit safeguards.

steps.title: Build Frontend Chat Widget

buildPlans.title: Customer Support Chatbot Build Plan
buildPlans.summary: Implement a multi‑channel customer support chatbot using Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Supabase. The plan covers architecture, database schema, backend API, frontend widget, integration with an LLM provider, and testing.

steps.title: Define System Architecture
steps.description: Create a high‑level diagram and document the components: Next.js frontend, API routes, Supabase DB, LLM proxy service, and channel adapters. Specify data flow for user auth, message ingestion, LLM request/response, and persistence.

steps.title: Implement Backend API & LLM Proxy
steps.description: Develop Next.js API routes (TypeScript) for: • /api/chat – receive user messages, forward to LLM, store response. • /api/knowledge – fetch docs/FAQs from Supabase. Add middleware for auth via Supabase JWT. Integrate with the chosen LLM using fetch/axios.

steps.title: Design Supabase Schema
steps.description: Create tables and relationships: users, conversations, messages, knowledge_sources. Enable Row Level Security (RLS) policies for user‑scoped access. Add indexes for fast retrieval of recent messages.

steps.title: Build Frontend Chat Widget
steps.description: Create a reusable React component with TailwindCSS styling: ChatWidget, MessageList, MessageInput, Loading/Error states. Implement real‑time updates via Supabase subscriptions. Export the widget as an npm package for easy embedding in website and mobile apps.

steps.title: Integrate Frontend with Backend & Configure Channels
steps.description: Wire the ChatWidget to the /api/chat endpoint using the Supabase client for auth and real‑time message sync. Add channel adapters: • Web widget embed script • React Native wrapper for mobile • Simple webhook bridge for WhatsApp (via Twilio). Configure environment variables for LLM API keys and Supabase URL/anon key.

steps.title: Testing & Deployment Preparation
steps.description: Write unit tests for API routes (Jest), component tests for ChatWidget (React Testing Library), and end‑to‑end tests using Cypress simulating multi‑channel interactions. Set up CI pipeline to run tests, lint, and deploy to Vercel with Supabase edge functions.

risks: Latency or rate‑limit issues from the LLM provider could affect response times.
Storing sensitive user data in Supabase requires careful compliance and encryption handling.
assumptions: Supabase will be used for authentication, real‑time database, and storage of conversation history.
An external LLM API (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) is available with appropriate credentials.
Channel adapters (website widget, mobile app, WhatsApp) will consume the same REST/WebSocket endpoints.
